versions.changelog:
arxiv-paper-resolver 1.0.1

- No file changes in this version; content and behavior remain unchanged.

arxiv-paper-resolver v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Accepts arXiv paper links and automates extraction of section structure, PDF download, and HTML parsing.
- Generates and archives a Chinese translated markdown document, organized by the paper’s own chapter structure.
- Preserves LaTeX math with strict `$...$` delimiters; skips references, HTML anchors, and extraneous formatting for maximum Typora compatibility.
- Outputs include: original PDF, metadata, per-section raw text, and the final Chinese document—all sorted by paper title directory.
- Provides detailed instructions, strict format requirements, and a single entry script for easy integration.
